claim: Onboarding OB-6, gateway half (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6). AuthService.queueEmailVerification races GmailService.sendEmail against VERIFICATION_SEND_BOUND_MS (8 s; the session's call, unmeasured against production Gmail, whose messages.send has no timeout) and answers a third VerificationMail outcome, 'unconfirmed', for a send still open at the bound; it is never 'not_sent' (it may still leave) and the late answer is still logged. A resend on a hung send answers { sent: false, verificationMail: 'unconfirmed' }. verifyEmailWithCode tags a verify_email code's refusal with CODE_REFUSED or CODE_SPENT (400) or CODE_LOCKED_FOR_THE_DAY (429), message unchanged, so the page can word it from status and code. Behavioural proof: apps/api-gateway/src/auth/verification-mail-timeout.spec.ts and verify-email-code-refusal-codes.spec.ts, which fail against origin/fix/verify-mail-carries-a-code 6855173fb's auth.service.ts.
verify: grep -qF 'export type VerificationMail = "sent" | "not_sent" | "unconfirmed";' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'export const VERIFICATION_SEND_BOUND_MS = 8_000;' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'setTimeout(() => resolve(null), VERIFICATION_SEND_BOUND_MS)' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'return "unconfirmed";' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'code: "CODE_SPENT"' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'code: "CODE_REFUSED"' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF 'code: "CODE_LOCKED_FOR_THE_DAY"' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && test -f apps/api-gateway/src/auth/verification-mail-timeout.spec.ts && test -f apps/api-gateway/src/auth/verify-email-code-refusal-codes.spec.ts
